01 / CONTRIBUTION

Original Flutter app delivery

Developed the original mobile version: interfaces, user journeys, REST API integration, state and data handling, bilingual support and maintainable structure.

  • Implemented the original mobile UI and connected user journeys.
  • Integrated REST APIs and managed application data and state.
  • Supported Arabic, English and right-to-left layouts.
  • Delivered an organized Flutter foundation for continued development.
Scope & status

The app belongs to its owner. My contribution covers the original mobile version; later changes by another team are not attributed to me. Store images show the published listing and may include those later changes.
